t=; if [ "$TOOLU_RUNTIME" != bun ]; then if [ -n "$TOOLU_BIN" ]; then set -- "$TOOLU_BIN"; else set -- /opt/homebrew/bin/toolu /usr/local/bin/toolu /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/toolu "$HOME/.local/bin/toolu" "$(command -v toolu 2>/dev/null)"; fi; for c in "$@"; do if [ -n "$c" ] && [ -f "$c" ] && [ -x "$c" ]; then case $("$c" --hook-protocol 2>/dev/null </dev/null) in ''|*[!0-9]*) ;; *) t=$c; break;; esac; fi; done; if [ -n "$t" ]; then "$t" hook pre-tools --event PreToolUse --plugin-root "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; s=$?; case $s in 0|2) exit $s;; esac; printf '%s\n' "blocked: toolu plugin: toolu ended with status $s, so the action is blocked. See docs/install.md." >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; if [ "$TOOLU_RUNTIME" = bun ] || [ -z "$TOOLU_BIN" ]; then b=; for c in "$TOOLU_BUN" "$(command -v bun 2>/dev/null)" "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun"; do if [ -n "$c" ] && [ -f "$c" ] && [ -x "$c" ]; then b=$c; break; fi; done; if [ -n "$b" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dist/pre-tools.js" ]; then if [ "$TOOLU_RUNTIME" = bun ]; then printf '%s\n' 'toolu plugin: TOOLU_RUNTIME=bun selected the transition Bun bundle.' >&2; else printf '%s\n' 'toolu plugin: native toolu not found, running the Bun bundle for this transition release - see #425. Install toolu with: curl -fsSL https://get.toolu.sh/pkg/toolu/install | bash or: brew install falconiere/tap/toolu.' >&2; fi; exec "$b" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dist/pre-tools.js"; fi; fi; printf '%s\n' 'blocked: toolu plugin: no usable native toolu - checked TOOLU_BIN, /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin, ~/.local/bin and PATH. If TOOLU_BIN is set, it must point to a native toolu and is never replaced. Install toolu with: curl -fsSL https://get.toolu.sh/pkg/toolu/install | bash, or: brew install falconiere/tap/toolu. Then restart the session. See docs/install.md.' >&2; exit 2
